title: Mechanism of Action of Ermiao San on Rheumatoid Arthritis Based on Bioinformatics and Molecular Dynamics.
authors: Xiao, Jianwei; Wang, Rongsheng; Cai, Xu; Huang, Xinmin; Ye, Zhizhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药二妙散治疗类风湿关节炎的机制，涉及分子对接与动力学，但对象为药物-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ermiao San, one of the Chinese medicine formulas, has been widely used to treat rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Our previous study has demonstrated that Ermiao San is effective in treating RA. However, its pharmacological mechanisms remain unclear. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to decipher the potential mechanism of action of Ermiao San in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) by bioinformatics, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics. METHODS: Gene expression data (GSE77298) were obtained from the GEO database. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were analyzed by R. The active ingredients of Huangbai (Phellodendron) and Cangshu (Atractylodes), two main constituents of Ermiao San, and their predicted target genes were retrieved from the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology (TCMSP) platform. Gene Ontology (GO) functional annotation and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment analyses were performed using the overlapping genes between DEGs of the RA dataset and the predicted target genes of Ermiao San. The gene-gene interaction network was analyzed and visualized by Cytoscape. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations were performed to study the interaction between selected target genes (Chemokine ligand 2 (CCL2) and matrix metalloproteinase 1 (MMP1)) and active ingredients (quercetin and wogonin) of Ermiao San. RESULTS: A total of 16 potential targets for Ermiao San were identified, with significantly enriched GO terms, such as cytokine-mediated signaling pathways, oxidoreductase activity, cell space, etc., and IL-17 signaling pathway, rheumatoid arthritis pathway, and NF-kappaB signaling pathway were identified as enriched pathways through KEGG analysis. CCL2 and MMP1 were identified and verified to be the targets of both quercetin and wogonin, the two active ingredients of Ermiao San, by molecular docking and molecular dynamics. CONCLUSION: Ermiao San may target CCL2 and MMP1 via its active ingredients by exerting therapeutic effects on RA.
abstract_zh: 背景：二妙散作为中药方剂之一，已被广泛用于治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）。我们先前的研究已证明二妙散对治疗RA有效。然而，其药理机制仍不清楚。因此，本研究旨在通过生物信息学、网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学，解析二妙散在类风湿关节炎（RA）中的潜在作用机制。方法：从GEO数据库获取基因表达数据（GSE77298）。利用R分析差异表达基因（DEGs）。从传统中药系统药理学（TCMSP）平台检索二妙散两种主要成分黄柏（Phellodendron）和苍术（Atractylodes）的活性成分及其预测靶基因。使用RA数据集的DEGs与二妙散预测靶基因之间的重叠基因，进行基因本体（GO）功能注释和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集分析。通过Cytoscape分析并可视化基因-基因相互作用网络。进行分子对接和动力学模拟，以研究选定靶基因（趋化因子配体2（CCL2）和基质金属蛋白酶1（MMP1））与二妙散活性成分（槲皮素和汉黄芩素）之间的相互作用。结果：共鉴定出16个二妙散的潜在靶点，显著富集的GO术语包括细胞因子介导的信号通路、氧化还原酶活性、细胞空间等，并通过KEGG分析确定富集通路为IL-17信号通路、类风湿关节炎通路和NF-kappaB信号通路。通过分子对接和分子动力学，CCL2和MMP1被鉴定并验证为二妙散两种活性成分槲皮素和汉黄芩素的靶点。结论：二妙散可能通过其活性成分靶向CCL2和MMP1，从而对RA发挥治疗作用。
